runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text: OMB M-25-22 takes effect 180 days after it was issued. The memorandum covers any contract awarded under a solicitation issued on or after the date 180 days after its issuance, along with options to renew or extend an existing contract exercised after that date. It does not cover AI acquired as a component of a National Security System.
